data.text: John, Kate, Jack, Emma—since I’m new, I’d like to sit out this month and let you four take the earnings. My proposal: you each catch 14 tons, and I catch zero. That’s $14,000 apiece and 56 tons total. It leaves 44 tons, which doubles to 88 next month. This isn’t a sustainable monthly quota, so next month I propose we collectively limit the catch to 38 tons, leaving 50 to restore the lake to 100 after reproduction. Think of this as a one-month bonus for the established crew, followed by a recovery month—not a permanent increase. If you’re willing, please actually select 14 tons when you submit your catch this month. John, are you in?
